monza.title: Turn 1 — Variante del Rettifilo T1
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Heavy 350 km/h braking zone into Monza's tightest chicane. Famous for opening-lap scrambles, including Max Verstappen's car landing on top of Lewis Hamilton's Halo in 2021.

monza.title: Turn 2 — Variante del Rettifilo T2
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Traction-critical exit from the Rettifilo chicane. A driver's launch here dictates top speed all the way down Curva Grande towards Lesmo.

monza.title: Turn 3 — Curva Grande (Biassono)
monza.subtitle: Sweeper — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: A flat-out 305 km/h sweeping curve through Monza's royal park, pulling 3.5G while accelerating into the dense forest canopy.

monza.title: Turn 4 — Variante della Roggia T4
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Second chicane named after the ancient water canal below the track. A primary slipstream overtaking zone where cars bounce aggressively over sausage kerbs at 120 km/h.

monza.title: Turn 5 — Variante della Roggia T5
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Exit of Roggia chicane where drivers clip the kerb to maximize acceleration towards the twin Lesmo curves.

monza.title: Turn 6 — Curva di Lesmo 1
monza.subtitle: Medium-Speed — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Blind right-hand apex surrounded by royal pine trees. Demands total commitment at 170 km/h where any drift wide costs vital momentum.

monza.title: Turn 7 — Curva di Lesmo 2
monza.subtitle: Medium-Speed — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Technical right-hand corner opening into Curva del Serraglio. Site of famous overtakes by Charles Leclerc, Sebastian Vettel, and Michael Schumacher fighting for Tifosi glory.

monza.title: Turn 8 — Variante Ascari T8
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Fast left-right-left chicane named after 2-time World Champion Alberto Ascari, who tragically lost his life nearby in 1955. Demands razor-sharp balance at 240 km/h.

monza.title: Turn 9 — Variante Ascari T9
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Mid-section of Variante Ascari where cars pull maximum lateral G-forces across the high-speed direction change.

monza.title: Turn 10 — Variante Ascari T10
monza.subtitle: Chicane — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Exit of Ascari launching cars onto the back straight towards Parabolica at over 260 km/h.

monza.title: Turn 11 — Curva Parabolica (Curva Michele Alboreto)
monza.subtitle: High-Speed Sweeper — Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: Iconic 180-degree sweeping right-hand arc renamed in 2021 after Italian hero Michele Alboreto. Drivers balance on the edge of grip at 210 km/h to rocket down the 1.1km pit straight.

silverstone.title: Turn 1 — Abbey
silverstone.subtitle: Blistering 290 km/h Right-Hand Apex
silverstone.description: Blisteringly fast 290 km/h right-hand corner opening the lap right past the Silverstone Wing. Cars carry massive downforce with only a brush of brakes.

silverstone.title: Turn 2 — Farm Curve
silverstone.subtitle: Sweeping Flat-Out Left Bend into Arena
silverstone.description: Flat-out sweeping left bend connecting Abbey into the technical Arena infield complex. Cars pull over 3.2 lateral G while maintaining full throttle.

silverstone.title: Turn 3 — Village
silverstone.subtitle: Heavy Braking Right Hairpin Apex
silverstone.description: Violent deceleration zone where cars shed 180 km/h in under 60 meters. Prime overtaking hotspot into the right-hand Arena corner named after Silverstone Village.

silverstone.title: Turn 4 — The Loop
silverstone.subtitle: Tight 180° Left-Hand Hairpin Apex
silverstone.description: The slowest corner on the entire Silverstone Grand Prix circuit. Demands sharp mechanical rotation down in 2nd gear and delicate traction on exit.

silverstone.title: Turn 5 — Aintree
silverstone.subtitle: Slingshot Acceleration Left onto Wellington Straight
silverstone.description: Left-hand slingshot exiting the Arena. Smooth traction here dictates top speed down the entire Wellington Straight DRS overtaking zone.

silverstone.title: Turn 6 — Brooklands
silverstone.subtitle: Heavy Trail-Braking Left Entry
silverstone.description: Hard braking zone at the end of Wellington Straight. Drivers brake while loaded left, making trail-braking overtakes and lockups frequent.

silverstone.title: Turn 7 — Luffield
silverstone.subtitle: Endless Double-Apex Right Carousel
silverstone.description: Endless right-hand double-apex carousel named after the ancient Augustinian priory. Severe front-left tyre degradation corner rewarded by patient throttle.

silverstone.title: Turn 8 — Woodcote
silverstone.subtitle: High-Speed Right Sweep onto National Straight
silverstone.description: Historic sweeping right-hand curve taken nearly flat-out in modern ground-effect machinery, launching cars onto the National Straight toward Copse.

silverstone.title: Turn 9 — Copse
silverstone.subtitle: 290 km/h Blind Ultra-Fast Apex
silverstone.description: One of the most fearsome corners in global motorsport. Taken in 7th gear at 290 km/h with an aggressive blind entry, clipping the apex kerb under 4.8 lateral G.

silverstone.title: Turn 10 — Maggotts
silverstone.subtitle: 300+ km/h Ess-Complex Entry Flick
silverstone.description: Entry flick of the legendary Maggotts-Becketts-Chapel roller coaster. High-speed left taken nearly flat-out exceeding 300 km/h at 5.1 lateral G.

silverstone.title: Turn 11 — Becketts 1
silverstone.subtitle: Violent Lateral Direction Change Right
silverstone.description: Furious right flick directly following Maggotts. Peak aerodynamic downforce reverses lateral load violently at 5.2 G without losing forward momentum.

silverstone.title: Turn 12 — Becketts 2
silverstone.subtitle: Tightening Left Apex into Chapel
silverstone.description: Tightening left-hander in the heart of Becketts. Downshifts to 5th gear scrub speed while setting up the crucial slingshot through Chapel onto Hangar Straight.

silverstone.title: Turn 13 — Chapel
silverstone.subtitle: Downhill Slingshot onto Hangar Straight
silverstone.description: Fast downhill right-hand exit opening onto the 770m Hangar Straight. Drivers mount the exit kerb aggressively under full power.

silverstone.title: Turn 14 — Hangar Straight Kink
silverstone.subtitle: 330+ km/h Full-Throttle DRS Blast
silverstone.description: Gentle kink along the full-throttle Hangar Straight where cars reach maximum velocity exceeding 330 km/h with DRS deployed before threshold braking into Stowe.

silverstone.title: Turn 15 — Stowe
silverstone.subtitle: High-Speed End of Straight Right Turn
silverstone.description: Brutal braking zone from top speed into a fast 5th-gear right turn beneath the Rolex bridge, with extreme track limit challenges on the exit run-off.

silverstone.title: Turn 16 — Vale
silverstone.subtitle: Downhill Heavy Braking Chicane Entry
silverstone.description: Downhill braking zone into a tight 2nd-gear left turn. Premier overtaking zone on the lap, leading directly into the Club stadium complex.

silverstone.title: Turn 17 — Club Corner Entry
silverstone.subtitle: Stadium Complex Double-Apex Right Kink
silverstone.description: Right-hand turn in front of the massive grandstands of the Silverstone Wing complex, setting up the line for the final exit onto Hamilton Straight.

silverstone.title: Turn 18 — Club Corner Exit / Hamilton Straight
silverstone.subtitle: Final Slingshot past Paddock Wing to Finish Line
silverstone.description: Final acceleration curve opening onto the 770m start/finish Hamilton Straight. Traction on exit decides straight-line speed into Turn 1 Abbey.

spa.title: Turn 1 — La Source
spa.subtitle: Hairpin — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Downhill hairpin named after Ardennes mineral springs. Famous for dramatic opening lap scrambles, including the 13-car pileup in 1998 and Fernando Alonso's airborne crash over Leclerc in 2018.

spa.title: Turn 2 — Eau Rouge
spa.subtitle: Compression Kink — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Compression dip at the base of Eau Rouge stream. Cars compress under 5G of vertical force before climbing the 17% gradient.

spa.title: Turn 3 — Raidillon
spa.subtitle: Crest Complex — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: The blind uphill right turn into Raidillon. Drivers take this crest flat-out at 300+ km/h relying entirely on muscle memory and downforce.

spa.title: Turn 4 — Kemmel Straight Kink
spa.subtitle: Full Throttle Straight — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Summit of Raidillon launching cars onto the 2km Kemmel Straight.

spa.title: Turn 5 — Les Combes (Entry)
spa.subtitle: Medium-Speed Chicane — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Les Combes chicane at the highest point of the circuit (Hautes Fagnes), the primary overtaking zone after slipstreaming up Kemmel.

spa.title: Turn 6 — Les Combes (Apex)
spa.subtitle: Medium-Speed Chicane — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Middle apex of Les Combes requiring smooth weight transfer.

spa.title: Turn 7 — Malmedy
spa.subtitle: Off-Camber Right — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Exit of Les Combes leading downhill towards Malmedy and Bruxelles.

spa.title: Turn 8 — Rivage (Bruxelles Hairpin)
spa.subtitle: Downhill Hairpin — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Off-camber 180-degree downhill right hairpin where front tires struggle for grip over the steep gradient.

spa.title: Turn 9 — Speaker's Corner (No Name)
spa.subtitle: Medium-Speed Left — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Fast downhill left-hand sweeper leading into the Ardennes forest valley.

spa.title: Turn 10 — Pouhon (Double Gauche Entry)
spa.subtitle: High-Speed Left — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Super-fast 260 km/h downhill left corner pulling 5.2G of lateral load—a true test of driver bravery and aerodynamic downforce.

spa.title: Turn 11 — Pouhon (Double Gauche Apex)
spa.subtitle: High-Speed Left — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Second apex of Pouhon, taken with progressive throttle as the track opens up.

spa.title: Turn 12 — Les Fagnes (Entry)
spa.subtitle: Right Chicane — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Technical right-left chicane over high kerbs surrounded by dense pine forests.

spa.title: Turn 13 — Les Fagnes (Exit)
spa.subtitle: Left Chicane — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Exit of Fagnes heading downhill towards Stavelot.

spa.title: Turn 14 — Campus / Stavelot
spa.subtitle: Medium Right — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Banked right-hand curve sweeping past Stavelot village towards the ultra-fast back section.

spa.title: Turn 15 — Courbe Paul Frère
spa.subtitle: High-Speed Right — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Fast right kink maintaining 280+ km/h momentum towards Paul Frère corner.

spa.title: Turn 16 — Blanchimont (Entry)
spa.subtitle: Ultra High-Speed Left — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Sweeping curve named after Belgian racing journalist and driver Paul Frère.

spa.title: Turn 17 — Blanchimont (Apex)
spa.subtitle: Ultra High-Speed Left — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Terrifying 300+ km/h left-hand sweep where Kimi Räikkönen famously passed Michael Schumacher through thick tire smoke in 2004.

spa.title: Turn 18 — Bus Stop Chicane (Entry)
spa.subtitle: Heavy Braking Right — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Exit of Blanchimont leading into the final heavy braking zone.

spa.title: Turn 19 — Bus Stop Chicane (Exit)
spa.subtitle: Chicane Exit Left — Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: Bus Stop chicane entry—a massive 320 to 80 km/h braking zone originally routed around an actual public bus stop.

monaco.title: Turn 1 — Sainte Dévote
monaco.subtitle: 90-Degree Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Right-hand corner named after Monaco's patron saint and 11th-century chapel. Infamous for turn-1 funneling crashes into the Beau Rivage hill.

monaco.title: Turn 2 — Beau Rivage
monaco.subtitle: Uphill Kink — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Blind uphill climb past luxury hotel balconies where V10 and hybrid engines echo off Monte Carlo cliffs.

monaco.title: Turn 3 — Massenet
monaco.subtitle: Long Sweeper — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Long left-hand curve leaning against outer armco barriers past the Opera de Monte-Carlo.

monaco.title: Turn 4 — Casino Square
monaco.subtitle: Medium-Speed Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Sweeping right corner past the Casino de Monte-Carlo, where cars brush barriers inches from high society spectators.

monaco.title: Turn 5 — Mirabeau Haute
monaco.subtitle: Tight Downhill Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Downhill right-hand dip into the bumpy braking zone before the hairpin.

monaco.title: Turn 6 — Grand Hôtel Hairpin
monaco.subtitle: Slowest F1 Hairpin — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: The slowest corner in F1 (~45 km/h), requiring full steering lock as cars weave past the Fairmont hotel.

monaco.title: Turn 7 — Mirabeau Bas
monaco.subtitle: Downhill Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Downhill right turn into Portier where Ayrton Senna famously crashed out while leading the 1988 GP by 55 seconds.

monaco.title: Turn 8 — Portier
monaco.subtitle: Tight Right to Tunnel — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Tight right turn leading directly into the seaside tunnel.

monaco.title: Turn 9 — The Tunnel
monaco.subtitle: High-Speed Arc — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Blasting through the dark seaside tunnel at 290 km/h before blinding sunlight hits drivers at the exit.

monaco.title: Turn 10 — Nouvelle Chicane (Entry)
monaco.subtitle: Heavy Braking Left — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Heavy braking zone out of the tunnel onto the harbour edge, site of famous late-braking overtakes.

monaco.title: Turn 11 — Nouvelle Chicane (Exit)
monaco.subtitle: Right Apex — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Exit of Nouvelle Chicane accelerating along the harbour quay.

monaco.title: Turn 12 — Tabac
monaco.subtitle: High-Speed Left — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Fast left-hand sweep bordering superyachts, named after the historic tobacco shop on the harbour quay.

monaco.title: Turn 13 — Louis Chiron (Piscine Entry)
monaco.subtitle: Fast Left — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: High-speed S-chicane entry around the Rainier III nautical stadium.

monaco.title: Turn 14 — Piscine Sweeper
monaco.subtitle: Fast Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Right-hand flick over high kerbs inside the Swimming Pool complex.

monaco.title: Turn 15 — Swimming Pool Chicane (Entry)
monaco.subtitle: Chicane Left — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Tight left-right chicane exit where cars clip inner barriers at 200 km/h.

monaco.title: Turn 16 — Swimming Pool Chicane (Exit)
monaco.subtitle: Chicane Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Exit of Swimming Pool heading towards Rascasse.

monaco.title: Turn 17 — La Rascasse
monaco.subtitle: Tight Hairpin Right — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Tight hairpin named after the Rascasse seafood restaurant, infamous for Michael Schumacher's 2006 qualifying parking incident.

monaco.title: Turn 18 — Virage Antony Noghès
monaco.subtitle: Final Right Turn — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Apex of Rascasse requiring precise throttle control on slippery asphalt.

monaco.title: Turn 19 — Pit Straight
monaco.subtitle: Start Finish Line — Circuit de Monaco
monaco.description: Final right turn named after the founder of the Monaco Grand Prix who organized the first race in 1929.

suzuka.title: Turn 1 — (First Corner Entry)
suzuka.subtitle: High-Speed Right — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Fast sweeping downhill right turn taken at 280 km/h.

suzuka.title: Turn 2 — (First Corner Exit)
suzuka.subtitle: Medium Right — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Tightening right exit leading directly into the rhythmic S-Curves.

suzuka.title: Turn 3 — S Curves (Turn 3 First Left)
suzuka.subtitle: High-Speed Left — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: First left-hand turn of the flowing S-Curves.

suzuka.title: Turn 4 — S Curves (Turn 4 First Right)
suzuka.subtitle: High-Speed Right — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Right-hand rhythm turn requiring smooth weight transfer.

suzuka.title: Turn 5 — S Curves (Turn 5 Second Left)
suzuka.subtitle: High-Speed Left — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Left-hand turn through the S-Curves uphill climb.

suzuka.title: Turn 7 — Dunlop Curve
suzuka.subtitle: Uphill Left Sweeper — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Dunlop uphill long left curve where high lateral Gs wear the right-front tire.

suzuka.title: Turn 8 — Degner 1
suzuka.subtitle: Fast Right — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Degner 1—fast 240 km/h right turn named after Ernst Degner who crashed here in 1962.

suzuka.title: Turn 9 — Degner 2
suzuka.subtitle: Narrow Right Hairpin — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Degner 2—tight right-hander under the track bridge.

suzuka.title: Turn 10 — Underpass Hairpin Approach
suzuka.subtitle: Technical Left — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Hairpin approach under the 3D crossover bridge.

suzuka.title: Turn 11 — Hairpin
suzuka.subtitle: Tight Hairpin Left — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Hairpin—heavy braking zone and top overtaking spot surrounded by passionate Japanese fans.

suzuka.title: Turn 12 — 200R Sweeper
suzuka.subtitle: High-Speed Sweeper — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: 200R long sweeping right turn accelerating towards Spoon.

suzuka.title: Turn 14 — Spoon Curve (Exit)
suzuka.subtitle: Long Left Exit — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Spoon Curve exit—off-camber left turn opening onto the back straight.

suzuka.title: Turn 15 — 130R
suzuka.subtitle: Ultra High-Speed Left — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: 130R—terrifying 305 km/h left-hand sweep named after its 130m radius, site of Alonso's 2005 pass on Schumacher.

suzuka.title: Turn 16 — Casio Triangle Chicane (Entry)
suzuka.subtitle: Heavy Braking Right — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Casio Triangle chicane entry, site of Prost and Senna's championship-deciding collision in 1989.

suzuka.title: Turn 17 — Casio Triangle Chicane (Exit)
suzuka.subtitle: Chicane Exit Left — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Casio Triangle exit onto the main pit straight.

suzuka.title: Turn 18 — Final Corner
suzuka.subtitle: Control Line Sweeper — Suzuka Circuit
suzuka.description: Turn 18 (T18) at Suzuka International Racing Course (Japan) is an iconic corner taken at approximately high-speed. Renowned in Grand Prix racing heritage for intense wheel-to-wheel duels, trail-braking mastery, and defining critical lap time momentum.
